column2: A fortified ogre and goblin war camp in a wooded river valley at dusk: crude palisade of sharpened logs, hide tents, totem poles crowned with skulls, huge war drums beaten by goblins, bonfires and orange embers drifting into a smoky violet sky, burning farm village roofs in the distance. On a rocky outcrop stands the silhouette of an enormous ogre warlord with a giant spiked club. Accent color: ember orange.

A smugglers' den hidden beneath an old crooked roadside inn at night: stone cellar steps leading down into a vaulted underground canal, flat-bottomed boats loaded with crates and barrels, rope bridges, lanterns with greenish-amber glow, stacked contraband, hooded thieves and ninjas lurking on rafters and in the shadows, poison vials glinting, a mysterious cloaked illusionist with faint violet arcane sigils at the far end. Accent color: lantern amber and poison green.

An ancient underground crypt beneath ruined settlement stones: a wide staircase of black stone descending into a vast vaulted necropolis, rows of sarcophagi and burial niches with skulls, broken statues of kings, cold blue-white ghostly mist and wisps of souls rising, a distant throne of bones where a skeletal lich sorcerer glows faintly, phylactery light. Accent color: spectral pale cyan.

A desecrated subterranean temple of a demonic cult: colossal pillars carved with tentacled reliefs, hundreds of black candles, robed hooded cultists chanting in circles, a giant ritual circle on the floor bleeding crimson light, an enormous stone archway in the back tearing open into a swirling portal to the Abyss with a horned demonic silhouette emerging. Accent color: blood crimson and deep magenta.

A colossal volcanic dragon lair deep underground: rivers of molten lava, obsidian bridges, mountains of gold coins and treasure, kobold shrines with draconic idols, cultist banners, heat shimmer and flying embers, and a gigantic red dragon coiled on the hoard with wings half spread, eyes burning, smoke curling from its nostrils. Accent color: molten red-orange and gold.

An impossible aberrant labyrinth underground: twisting stone corridors that fold over themselves in non-euclidean geometry, stairs on walls and ceilings, fleshy organic growths and tentacles on the stone, floating small eyes, a mind flayer silhouette in a side passage, and at the center a massive floating beholder with one great central eye and many eyestalks shooting rays of colored light. Accent color: eerie arcane violet and sickly teal.
